hero.label: The Opportunity
hero.static_content: You have visibility and proof, but conversion pathways are leaking. Conversion work aligns demand signals with decisive offers, follow-up, and frictionless buyer movement.

foundation.label: What You've Built
foundation.static_content: Your market already pays attention. The bottleneck is not awareness but unclear sequencing between content, trust moments, and monetizable next steps.

gtm_strategy.label: The Play
gtm_strategy.static_content: Engineer the mid-funnel: tighten offer architecture, map objection handling into content, and deploy email and call-to-action sequences that move readers from interest to commitment.

roadmap.label: 90-Day Roadmap
roadmap.static_content: Phase 1: conversion diagnostics and message hierarchy. Phase 2: launch offer-path experiments and nurture sequence. Phase 3: optimize conversion assets from response data.

work_weve_done.label: Work We've Done
work_weve_done.static_content: Opika has repeatedly improved conversion outcomes by restructuring buyer journeys around proof, relevance, and timing rather than adding more channels.

ask.label: What We're Asking
ask.static_content: Partner in a focused sprint to refine your path from attention to action. You bring expertise and feedback; we build the system and optimize every handoff.
